paper.title: Detection of Obstructive Sleep Apnea from Cardiac Interbeat Interval Time Series
paper.claim: The historical method uses oscillatory normal-to-normal interval dynamics to identify periods associated with prolonged high-density obstructive sleep apnea.
paper.population: The historical evaluation combines public sleep-apnea, polysomnographic, and normal-sinus-rhythm data and is not a Brainstem device or population validation.
paper.referenceStandard: Expert respiratory or polysomnographic annotations in public PhysioNet datasets.
paper.relationEvidence: The checksum-pinned PhysioNet apdet 1.0.0 archive is the software linked from the authors' official method resource.

classification.unit: one-minute epoch within a full-night normal-to-normal interval series

sources.name: Official PhysioNet apdet 1.0.0 source archive
sources.license: GPL-2.0-or-later embedded notices; redistribution review pending

datasets.name: University College Dublin Sleep Apnea Database

compatibility.brainstemContract: brainstem.full-night-rr-cohort/v1: bounded 5-12 hour detector-R-R input; normal-to-normal provenance unverified and official-method compatibility false
requiredSignals: respiratory or polysomnographic reference labels for validation
compatibility.window: A continuous overnight interval series, historically seven to ten hours, evaluated in five-minute windows advanced once per minute.
compatibility.preprocessing: Official apdet 1.0.0 corrected pipeline, checksum-pinned in authority-freeze.json and source-audit.py.
mismatches: Brainstem interval records do not prove normal-to-normal beat classification.
Brainstem recordings do not contain respiratory or polysomnographic reference labels.
The current official package does not exactly reproduce the historical Apnea-ECG learning headline.
The precommitted UCDDB extension evaluated 23 of 25 participants and had 27.4923% aggregate minute sensitivity.
The UCDDB ECG adaptation and Brainstem records use detector R-R intervals that are not proven normal-to-normal.
No Brainstem device or population validation has been performed.

cohort.output: Execution withheld. Only the exact public reproduction, external-validation result, and limitations may be presented as non-executable evidence.

personal.output: Unavailable; no apnea label, score, probability, AHI, screening statement, or reassurance may be returned.

prohibitedClaims: negative or healthy interpretation of abstention
